configuration.purpose: Controlled WS-0 memory admission validation using unchanged W21 source/arithmetic. Run two syntheses concurrently with the all-image C simulation. Measure individual process-tree RSS, overlapping task timestamps, MemAvailable and CPU. Do not enable general hardware concurrency until this trial passes. No architecture speedup is claimed. The first trial F32/F33/F34 passed arithmetic/II and overlapped116.606s with minimum10.697GiB available and no OOM, but actual csynth tree RSS 3.119/3.430GiB exceeded its2.5GiB registration. Correct registration before enabling concurrency.
